name: Queen
source:
In appearance, a beautiful young girl with soft, adorable features. Although she's called the Queen, she doesn't hold any real authority.

She has very strong likes and dislikes. She is infatuated with Alice, while she hates the Cheshire Cat. Or rather, anyone other than Alice, she doesn't really care about. She likes tea, and so is actually rather friendly with the tea party folk.

[Edited from in-game profile]
